lockedDecisions.websiteVenturesPriority: Website selling is the primary near-term income engine.
lockedDecisions.agencyFirst: Joey's own Website Ventures / agency site is built first and sets the visual/technical ceiling before selling the claim to customers.
lockedDecisions.agencyFeel: Maximum-premium, calm Apple-like shell with strong typography, controlled spacing, integrated scroll/motion and excellent mobile execution.
lockedDecisions.agencyRole: The agency site is both showroom and R&D playground; it should demonstrate capability rather than only describe it.
lockedDecisions.firstCommercialNiche: Plumbing/trades remains the first commercial showcase and customer-template system.
lockedDecisions.startingGeography: Almere is the leading first area; Bussum can be useful because Joey already works there.
lockedDecisions.operatorPrinciple: Porsche treatment, authentic tradesperson: premium presentation is allowed while the worker remains credible and recognizably a real trade professional.
lockedDecisions.characterStrategy: One exceptional recurring Plumbing technician is preferred over many unrelated AI people.
lockedDecisions.proofIntegrity: Real completed client work, reviews, staff claims, certifications and measured results stay real. AI demo imagery may never masquerade as proof.
lockedDecisions.templateRule: Customer sites should be system/template-driven and highly reusable, with customer-specific copy, colors, photos and selected identity assets rather than rebuilding from zero.
lockedDecisions.mobileRule: Every important visual/interaction must have a deliberate mobile version; desktop-only wow is rejected.
lockedDecisions.higgsfieldRule: Manual higgsfield.ai is preferred for Unlimited exploration. Still/reference winners first; motion and 4K finish only after approval.
lockedDecisions.creditRule: When 50% of the paid generation balance remains, stop new paid generations and review winners, waste and remaining queue before spending more.
lockedDecisions.publicGamenfyPriority: Gamenfy Public remains a low-cost demand test and must not outrank Website Ventures without real repeated usage evidence.

workingCommercialHypotheses.foundingPrice: €349 is a working founding-offer hypothesis, not a permanent ceiling or final public price.
workingCommercialHypotheses.laterPrice: €499–€699 is a later working range once scope, quality and fulfilment are proven; not locked.
workingCommercialHypotheses.controlSession: A roughly €59 Website Control Session is a possible add-on; not locked.
workingCommercialHypotheses.domainOwnership: The customer should remain owner of their domain; Joey may manage DNS/hosting for convenience.
workingCommercialHypotheses.acquisition: Prefer active-buyer platforms, referrals, warm/local contacts and legally compliant outreach over generic spam or assumed cold-calling loopholes.

clientFulfilmentSystem.principle: One coded Plumbing master plus customer config, real customer assets/proof, selected reusable media and QA. Do not clone/rebuild HTML per customer by default.
configModes: Local drafts use Client Factory and ?wvlocal=1; they do not write GitHub.
Missing or broken client config keeps the hardcoded Plumbing fallback instead of breaking the page.
clientFulfilmentSystem.qaFixtureRule: plumbing-qa-blue is a technical fixture only; it is not an approved brand, offer or future flagship.
clientFulfilmentSystem.assetRule: Client config and Selected Assets are separate gates: changing customer copy/theme never auto-approves generated media.
clientFulfilmentSystem.proofRule: Reviews, certifications, project imagery, staff claims and measured outcomes must come from a real client source and are never invented by the config system.

measurement.decisionRule: Do not promise ultra-fast fulfilment or lock final pricing from template theory; use measured customer 1–10 evidence.

hero.desktopSource: 16:9, minimum 1920x1080, recognizable subject inside central 70% safe zone
hero.rule: One strong hero/visual-DNA master first; the static frame must already sell premium quality.

agencySlotRules.firstScroll: Reuse the selected hero through code/CSS/JS if possible; do not automatically generate a second asset.
agencySlotRules.plumbingShowcase: Use the real coded Plumbing demo and its approved visuals/screenshots for the agency showcase; do not pay for duplicate agency-specific AI media.
agencySlotRules.transformation: Code/screenshot first. Generate extra media only if the coded comparison fails to communicate the value.
agencySlotRules.interaction: Code first. Add generated media only after the reusable interaction technology itself proves useful.
agencySlotRules.proof: Real-source-only. Never generate the evidence itself.
agencySlotRules.cta: No new generation required unless an already-approved asset can be reused cheaply.
